Third-party software
====================

This directory vendors third-party libraries used by Radar Studio / Radar
Emulator. Project source outside this directory is licensed under the MIT
License; copyright is held by www.dandevlog.com. See the repository root
LICENSE file.

The notices below identify each bundled component and the license text that
accompanies it. License files already present in each library directory are
kept as-is.
